page_title: Dolzip — Unpack files. Make room for more.
meta_description: Fast, thoughtful archive tools for Mac. Extract with free DolUnzip, and do more with Dolzip.
hero_title: Unpack files. Make room for more.
hero_intro: Fast, thoughtful archive tools for Mac.
feature_speed_body: Extract with multiple cores where the format and data structure allow it.
feature_formats_body: Open ZIP, 7z, RAR, TAR, GZ and a wide range of disk images in one place.
feature_password_body: Enter your password to extract supported encrypted archives.
feature_split_body: Keep every part in the same folder. Related volumes are found automatically.
feature_preview_body: Explore contents and edit supported archives in paid Dolzip.
feature_cli_body: Automate listing, extraction, creation and testing with the free dz CLI.
formats_caveat: Supported codecs and features vary by format. Creating RAR, EGG and ALZ is not supported. Disk images and some legacy formats have limitations. Please report files that do not work.
disk_image_note: Extract files inside disk images, including FAT, NTFS and ext.
paid_features: App Store · Paid · Full features: create, extract, preview and edit
free_requirements: macOS 11 or later · Apple Silicon · Intel
paid_requirements: macOS 14 or later · Apple Silicon · Intel
faq_apps: DolUnzip — Free: Extraction only. Dolzip — App Store · Paid: Full features: create, extract, preview and edit.
faq_cli: dz — Free · Command-line tool: List · Extract · Create · Test · Edit.
getting_started_body: After release, drag the app to Applications. Drop an archive onto the window or choose a file, then select where to extract it.
privacy_body: The app collects no personal data or usage statistics. This site uses no analytics or cookies. GitHub’s privacy policy applies to hosting and downloads. Do not post passwords or sensitive files in public issues.
